summary.zh: 起草领英评论、私信与外联计划
summary.en: Draft LinkedIn comments, DMs and outreach plans.

description.zh: 为 LinkedIn 的评论、连接请求附言和私信起草内容，并规划分阶段的触达名单。适合日常互动维护，或在发起主动外联之前使用。同时会检查当日发送量是否在安全范围内。
description.en: Drafts LinkedIn comments, connection notes and direct messages, and plans who to reach out to in what order. Use it for routine engagement or before an outreach push; it also checks that daily volume stays within safe limits.
